responsibility: Defines the per-device data attachment mechanism used inside the gm2 channel subsystem. It introduces opaque module identifiers and free callbacks plus routines to allocate a ModuleId, attach arbitrary module-owned data to an IOLink device table, retrieve it later, and destroy it when the device or module no longer needs that state.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the RTdata pair, declaring the abstract ModuleId type and the routines for attaching, retrieving, and destroying device-associated module data; RTdata.mod contains the concrete ModuleId representation, linked-list storage on devices, and RTentity-based validity checking behind that API.
